risks.reasoning: The latest comparable cash-flow period, the six months ended 30 June 2020, shows positive net cash from operating activities of RMB359,667 thousand. Under Protocol v1.1.1, non-negative operating cash flow means there is no operating cash burn, so monthly operating cash burn and cash runway are null and the cash_runway risk is not applicable. Period-end cash and cash equivalents were RMB3,200,320 thousand.

The accountants' report shows profits in 2017 and 2018 and a loss in 2019; for comparable six-month periods it shows a profit for the six months ended 30 June 2019 and a loss for the six months ended 30 June 2020. There are therefore not two or three comparable loss periods, so the frozen continuous-loss threshold is not met.

All disclosed comparable revenue growth rates are positive: 2018 versus 2017, 2019 versus 2018, and the six months ended 30 June 2020 versus the corresponding 2019 period. None is below 0%, so neither the medium nor high frozen revenue-growth threshold is met.

For every disclosed track-record period, the five largest customers contributed less than 7% of total revenue and the largest customer contributed less than 6.5%. These strict upper bounds exclude both the medium thresholds (largest >=30% or top five >=60%) and the high thresholds (largest >=50% or top five >=80%).

For every disclosed track-record period, the five largest suppliers accounted for less than 30% of purchases and the largest supplier accounted for less than 16%. These strict upper bounds exclude both the medium thresholds (largest >=30% or top five >=60%) and the high thresholds (largest >=50% or top five >=80%).

The A and B preferred shares are disclosed as non-redeemable, but the pre-IPO shareholders agreement grants pre-IPO investors actual special rights, including pre-emptive, information, anti-dilution and veto rights, that remain in force until listing. The agreement clearly states that those special rights terminate after listing and the preferred shares convert 1:1 into ordinary shares, with no restoration language identified. Under the frozen redemption_rights policy, actual effective special rights are a review candidate; medium is retained only as the protocol's provisional candidate severity.

The formal Business disclosure states that during the track record period and up to the latest practicable date the group was not involved in material legal, arbitration or administrative proceedings and was not involved in material non-compliance events causing fines, enforcement action or other penalties with a material adverse effect. PRC legal counsel further states that all important licences and certificates had been obtained, major subsidiaries complied in all material respects, and no material legal obstacle to licence renewal was identified. Generic forward-looking regulatory uncertainty is therefore distinguished from an actual material pending or unresolved compliance matter.

The accountants' report records substantial revenue from sales of pharmaceutical and healthcare products in every disclosed period, including RMB7,693,261 thousand for the six months ended 30 June 2020. The core retail-pharmacy product business is therefore commercialized and has product-sales revenue, so the precommercial_product candidate condition is not met.
